idea: Ask a friend what game they enjoy and share one you like
prompt: Hi! What game do you enjoy playing? I like ____. What do you like about it?

activities.title: Game Talk
activities.prompt: Ask a friend what game they enjoy. Share one game you like too.

activities.title: Animal Chat
activities.prompt: Ask: Which animal do you like most? Then share one interesting thing about that animal.

activities.title: Weekend Story
activities.prompt: Ask: What was one fun thing you did this weekend? Listen and ask one follow-up question.

activities.title: Kind Compliment
activities.prompt: Tell someone one kind, specific thing: I like your drawing. What gave you the idea?

activities.title: Join In
activities.prompt: Try saying: Can I join you? What should I do first?

activities.title: Keep It Going
activities.prompt: After a friend answers, say: Really? Tell me more. Then listen.
